$comment: Usage notes per semantic group, shown on the Color page and in llms.txt. A token's own $description wins when present.
color.bg: Page backgrounds. default for the main canvas, subtle for side panels and zones that sit behind content.
color.surface: Anything that sits on the page: cards, inputs, menus. raised is for surfaces that also carry elevation.
color.text: Text and icons. default for body copy, muted for secondary info, disabled only for disabled controls, inverse on dark or brand fills, on-solid on feedback solid fills.
color.border: Dividers and outlines. default for quiet separators, strong for control edges that must be found.
color.action: Interactive controls only. Never use action colors for decoration, or users will try to click it.
color.feedback: Status and system messages. bg + text + border for inline messages, solid for compact labels like badges. Always pair with words.
focus: Keyboard focus ring. Shared by every focusable component so focus looks the same everywhere.
elevation: Shadows that lift surfaces. raised for cards, overlay for menus and dialogs. Stronger in dark mode so edges stay visible.
